title: analysis.state.compare result
description: Which fields the snapshots disagree about, and each one's value. The totals are exact whatever the report cap, because a capped count would be a fact about the request rather than about the machines.

name.description: The locator the request named it by, so a difference's positional values can be read back to a file.

sha256.description: The digest of the snapshot document, which is what pins the comparison.

identical.description: Whether every path present in any snapshot holds the same value in all of them.

paths_total.description: Paths compared across all snapshots, whether or not they differ.

values.description: Each snapshot's value, in the order the request named them. `null` is the field being absent from that snapshot, which is a difference of its own kind and is named rather than rendered as a value.

anyOf.description: What one leaf holds. Tagged, and deliberately not collapsed into a number: a pointer that compared equal to an integer of the same bit pattern would let a relocated address read as an unchanged value.

member.description: The name the project gives this value, when it names one. Absent means the stored number is not one the project enumerates, which is a finding rather than an error.

hex.description: Bytes, for a leaf whose type states a width this build cannot read as a scalar. Reported rather than skipped, so the field still appears in a comparison and still says it changed.
